verses.text: Hach hin Diosal, swal wach' lolonel t'ayach, manh hach b'at mikan t'a hin lesal.
Yujto ha heb' sk'ulan chukal yet' heb' tz'ak'an musansatil anima, chuk syal heb' t'a hin patik. Esnhej tas syal heb' chi' t'a hin patik.
Ha schichonk'olal heb' ste oymaj t'a hin patik. Tz'och chi'an sk'o'ol heb' t'ayin, palta malaj hin mul t'a heb'.
Ha spak hin wach'k'olal t'a heb', to tz'och heb' ajk'olal t'ayin. Ha hinxo jun, wan hin lesalwi yuj heb'.
Ha hin wach' pensaril t'a heb', chuk syutej heb' spaktzitan t'ayin. Haxo spak hin wach'k'olal t'a heb', to schichon sk'o'ol heb' t'ayin.
Ha junok winh chuk spensar tzak'och juezal t'a yib'anh winh. A'okab' junok yajk'o'ol winh tz'ak'ankanb'at t'a yib'anh.
Ayik sch'olb'itaj winh, alchajokab'i to ay smul winh. Ochokab' pax slesal winh smulok.
Tzapanokab' tzutej sk'inal winh. Ch'okokab' pax mach tz'ochkan t'a yopisio winh.
Meb'a' uninokab' tz'ajkan heb' yuninal winh. Haxo ix yetb'eyum winh, kanokab' ix t'a manh etb'eyumal.
Ek'okab' heb' yuninal winh sk'an wa sb'a t'a titak pat. Pechchajokab'el heb' b'aj ek'nak spat.
Ik'chajokab' ek' masanil tastak ay t'a heb' yuj winh tz'ak'an tumin majanil. Ik'chajokab'b'at smunlajel winh yuj heb' ch'ok anima'il.
Malajokab' mach tz'ok' sk'o'ol t'a winh. Malajokab' pax mach tz'ok' sk'o'ol t'a heb' yuninal winh meb'axo.
Satokab'el yinhtilal winh, satokab'el sb'i winh t'a jun'elnhej.
Mamin Jehová, nakot smul heb' smam yicham winh. Mokab' ha suk sat smul snun winh.
Na'anokab' smul heb' hu'uj. Mokxob' nachajkot heb' t'a sat lu'um tik.
Yujto manh na'anok yak'an wach'k'olal winh. Palta to ix och winh ajk'olal t'a heb' meb'a', t'a heb' anima emnakil yek'i yet' t'a heb' ayoch t'a ilk'olal, masanto smilcham heb' winh.
Skatab'ej anima winh, kotokab' katab' t'a yib'anh winh. Malajokab' b'ak'inh scha wach'k'olal winh yujto maj yak'laj swach'k'olal winh t'a heb' anima chi'.
Haxonhej katab' syal winh, ichato ha katab' chi' spichul winh yaji. Ha katab' chi', icha ha' sikil ha' skuk'ej, ma icha aceite sko sukek' t'ayonh, icha chi' yaj t'a winh.
Kotokab' yahelal t'a yib'anh sniwanil winh yuj skatab'an heb' anima chi', icha smuschaj ko niwanil yet' ko pichul. Ochokab'kan sut'an yahelal chi' t'a winh t'a masanil tiempo icha junok tzek'ul.
Mamin Jehová, icha'okab' tik tzutej heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, haton heb' tz'alan hin pekal.
Ha hachxo pax hach Jehová Wajalil, ak'kot ha wach'k'olal t'a wib'anh yik ol hach ik'jokcha'anh. Yuj ha wach'k'olal t'ayin, kolineli.
Te meb'a' hin, manhxo anima'ok wet'nak swutej wab'ani, icha wal to lajwinak hin swab'i.
Wan hin satel icha junok enhul. Wan wik'jib'at yuj ik' ichok nok' k'ulub'.
Wan yib'xi sjolom hin penek, manhxalaj wip yujto maxtzak hin walaj. Wan hin b'akb'i.
Tzeb'ajtak wilji t'a heb' anima. Ayik tzin yilan heb', sb'uchwaj heb' t'ayin.
Mamin Jehová, ochanh wet'ok. Hach hin Diosal, kolinel yuj ha wach'k'olal.
Mamin Jehová, yojtakejokab'el heb' anima to ha hach ix hin utej icha tik.
Malaj yelk'och hin skatab'an heb' tato ha hach tzak'kot ha wach'k'olal t'ayin. K'ixwokab' heb' yakb'an wan stzalaj hin k'o'ol ha hin ha chekab' hin tik.
Ha heb' tz'alan hin pekal, chamokab' heb' yuj k'ixwelal. Toxonhejokab' sat sk'o'ol heb' yuj k'ixwelal.
Mamin Jehová, ol wak' yuj diosal t'ayach t'a masanil tiempo. T'a skal tzijtumal anima ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach hach hin Diosal,
yujto Yalumal heb' meb'a' aji. Ha hach tza kolel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' snib'ej yak'anoch chamel t'a yib'anh heb'.
